statement: (let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; ∃ (k : ℕ) (X Y : Fin k → ℚ) (w : Fin k → ℕ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q ∧ (∑ j, w j) < 17*q ∧ ∀ x y a b : ℝ, (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*x ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*((4661/1000:ℝ)-x) ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*y ∧ |a| + |b| ≤ 2*((4661/1000:ℝ)-y)) → q ≤ (∑ j : Fin k, (if inside x y a b (X j) (Y j) then w j else 0))) → (let inside := fun (x y a b X Y : ℝ) => |a*(X-x)+b*(Y-y)| < 1/2 ∧ |(-b)*(X-x)+a*(Y-y)| < 1/2; let fits := fun (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) => 0 ≤ s ∧ ∃ x y a b : Fin n → ℝ, (∀ i, a i ^ 2 + b i ^ 2 = 1 ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*x i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-x i) ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*y i ∧ |a i| + |b i| ≤ 2*(s-y i)) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ X Y : ℝ, inside (x i) (y i) (a i) (b i) X Y → ¬ inside (x j) (y j) (a j) (b j) X Y); ¬ fits 17 (4661/1000))

plain_statement.zh: 把加权击中点证书组合成 17 块装不下的结论。
plain_statement.en: Turn a weighted piercing certificate into impossibility for seventeen squares.

brief.zh: 用每块严格内部互不相交，保证每个见证点的权重至多计入一次。
brief.en: Disjoint interiors ensure each site's weight is charged at most once.
